{{Quote|I hear bad things about smugglers.|A spacer, to Tarand Crowe|<ref name="SWG:S" />}}
'''Tarand Crowe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I just need someone to drop this off. Someone who is not me. I am being watched. You are new here, and should be able to move around without suspicion.|Tarand Crowe, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:S" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tarand Crowe was working on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. While he was on the station, he would [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] goods from place to place.<ref name="SWG:S" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> He was contacted by an individual named [[Maghr Scutu]] who was looking for a rare plant that grew in the station's atrium. Scutu wanted to obtain a portion of this plant as it could be used to make [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Crowe accepted but he was not able to perform the job himself since he was watched by the authorities of the station. He instead recruited a spacer who agreed with serving as an intermediate. The spacer therefore met Maghr Scutu who provided information about the delivery and then managed to steal a portion of the plant undetected. The spacer later launched into space in his own [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], traveled to a rendezvous point in the Bright Jewel system and delivered the plant to another ship piloted by one of Scutu's henchman. Tarand Crowe later paid the spacer for the successful delivery.<ref name="SWG:S" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarand Crowe was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:S" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tarand Crowe was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:S" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
